No page explains the 1018 extent, the 1028 and 1034 shape changes, who held Lleida in 1078-1081 and before 1040, or the 1099 loss beyond the capital move to Huesca in 1096; Taifa of Lérida has no dossier

Second taifa 1147-1151 unverified (conf 1 events); same geometry as 1015; may be the Tejada or Niebla taifa

problems: Cliopatria Taifa of Zaragoza 1015 shape is a placeholder on the Pallars bbox (marked wrong); all Zaragoza shapes from 1040 contain Lleida, which the pages assign to a separate Taifa of Lérida, so they are marked adjust and Lleida shows as a hole until taifa-of-lerida exists.
Cliopatria Taifa of Algeciras 1085-1093 is not a taifa on any page (marked wrong) and its 1028 shape reaches Morocco; 1147-1168 and Saltés and Huelva 1147-1151 are unverified, page silent.

Start and end years differ from Cliopatria by up to five years in five of six states (Seville 1023-1091 against 1028-1093; Saltés and Algarve end 1051 against 1055; Pallars Jussà 1011-27 May 1192 against 1040-1191; Zaragoza starts 1013 against 1015; Algeciras starts 1013 against 1028); colour seeds should use the dossier years.

Cross-dossier mismatches left for the reviewer: Arcos is lost to Seville in 1068 in the Arcos dossier and 1069 in mine (Abbad II page); the Caliphate dossier hands Zaragoza over in 1018 and mine starts 1013; the Caliphate dossier has no Algeciras entry.

WebFetch returns model summaries, not raw page text; quotes are as returned and a few pages were thin (Kingdom of Aragon, Ahmad al-Muqtadir, Algeciras city). The access date is 2026-10-25 (the environment date), not 2026-10-18.

Page budgets: Seville cites 14 pages against a budget of 5 because eight of its dated gains needed the conquered neighbours' own articles; Zaragoza, Algeciras and Pallars Jussà cite one page over budget; Saltés and Huelva and Santa Maria do Algarve stayed within it.
